recognize_zh: 這是毛細管血紅素電泳報告：HbS 49.7% 為最高峰，同時存在 HbA 36.1%、HbF 11.2%、HbA2 3.0%；HbS 大於 HbA，不符合單純鐮刀型特質（sickle trait），需考慮輸血後的鐮刀型貧血或 HbS/β+ 地中海貧血。
features: Capillary electrophoresis trace with four peaks: Hb A, Hb F, Hb S and Hb A2 in order of migration
Hb S is the dominant fraction at 49.7%, exceeding Hb A at 36.1%
Hb A2 3.0%, within the stated reference range 2.5-3.5%
No additional variant peaks (e.g., Hb C or Hb D zones) identified
describe_en: Capillary hemoglobin electrophoresis shows Hb S 49.7%, Hb A 36.1%, Hb F 11.2% and Hb A2 3.0%, with no other variant peaks. The proportion of Hb S exceeds Hb A, which is not the pattern of sickle cell trait, where Hb A predominates and Hb S is usually below 45%. Together with the elevated Hb F, this pattern is most compatible with sickle cell anemia after recent red cell transfusion, or alternatively Hb S/beta-plus thalassemia; transfusion history, red cell indices and family or DNA studies are needed to distinguish these.

ddx.vs: Trait shows Hb A greater than Hb S (typically Hb S 35-45%) with normal Hb F and normal red cell indices.
S/beta-plus has Hb S greater than Hb A with microcytosis and a raised Hb A2 (often above 3.5%) without a recent transfusion.

ddx.dx: Sickle cell anemia on hydroxyurea without transfusion
ddx.vs: Untransfused Hb SS shows no Hb A peak, with Hb F that may be markedly elevated on hydroxyurea.

ddx.dx: Hb S with hereditary persistence of fetal hemoglobin
ddx.vs: S/HPFH shows no Hb A with Hb F around 20-30% distributed pancellularly and a mild clinical course.
